lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is Mountain Village Town Council's first reading of an ordinance that would move Housing Authority fees out of the municipal code into an annually updated fee schedule — a structural shift in how affordable housing costs get set that's worth understanding before it advances. San Miguel County's Housing Code SSR working group also meets Tuesday for its eighth session, zeroing in on proposed changes to strip Land Use Code provisions that slow workforce housing production. Meanwhile, HARC takes up a work session on a potential demolition and new construction at Rebekah Hall — the Town-owned building at 113 W Columbia where HARC itself meets — and the BOCC tackles a land-use MOU tied to a 1999 view-plain settlement.

notable.stake: County working group shapes code changes that affect workforce housing production.
